contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen

actions.description: It will check you through these steps

steps: Inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Turn off your phone or tablet.
Insert the ejector tool into the small hole next to the SIM/MicroSD tray.
Eject the tray.
Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.
Check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI).

actions.description: It will restart you through these steps

steps: Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds.
Reinsert the battery.

actions.description: It will guide you through these steps

steps: Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger.
Let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will guide you through these steps

steps: Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Press and hold the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
